# Nitric Boost Ultra

> Nitric Boost Ultra is a Health & Fitness > Men's Health > Nitric Oxide & Blood Flow Support Supplement. Nitric Boost Ultra is a natural nitric oxide support supplement positioned in the men's health space. Its formula is built around ingredients traditionally used to support healthy blood flow, which in turn supports energy, vitality and physical performance during daily activity and workouts. It is taken as part of a regular daily routine rather than as a one-off pick-me-up, and it is aimed at men who want to support circulation and stamina as they go about their normal day.
